verses.en: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.
verses.pt: E eu vi outro grande e admirável sinal no céu: sete anjos, que tinham as sete últimas pragas; porque nelas a ira de Deus se torna completa.
verses.en_web: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.
verses.en_bbe: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and strange; seven angels having the seven last punishments, for in them the wrath of God is complete.

verses.en: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.
verses.pt: E eu vi como um mar de vidro misturado como fogo; e aos que venceram a besta, a sua imagem, e sua marca, e o número de seu nome, os quais estavam de pé junto ao mar de vidro, e tinham harpas de Deus;
verses.en_web: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.
verses.en_bbe: And I saw a sea which seemed like glass mixed with fire; and those who had overcome the beast and his image and the number of his name, were in their places by the sea of glass, with God's instruments of music in their hands.

verses.en: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
verses.pt: E cantavam o cântico de Moisés, o servo de Deus, e o cântico do Cordeiro, dizendo: “Grandes e maravilhosas são as tuas obras, ó Senhor Deus Todo-Poderoso! Teus caminhos são justos e verdadeiros, ó Rei dos santos!
verses.en_web: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.
verses.en_bbe: And they give the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and full of wonder are your works, O Lord God, Ruler of all; true and full of righteousness are your ways, eternal King.

verses.en: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.
verses.pt: Quem não te temeria, ó Senhor, e não glorificaria o teu nome? Porque só tu és santo; porque todas as nações virão, e adorarão diante de ti, porque os teus juízos foram manifestos!”
verses.en_web: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”
verses.en_bbe: What man is there who will not have fear before you, O Lord, and give glory to your name? because you only are holy; for all the nations will come and give worship before you; for your righteousness has been made clear.

verses.en: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
verses.pt: E depois disto eu olhei, e eis que o templo do tabernáculo do testemunho foi aberto no céu.
verses.en_web: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
verses.en_bbe: And after these things I saw, and the house of the Tent of witness in heaven was open:

verses.en: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.
verses.pt: E os sete anjos, que tinham as sete pragas, saíram do templo, vestidos de linho puro e brilhante, e cingidos com cintos de ouro ao redor dos peitos.
verses.en_web: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their breasts.
verses.en_bbe: And the seven angels who had the seven punishments came out from the house of God, clothed with linen, clean and bright and with bands of gold about their breasts.

verses.en: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.
verses.pt: E um dos quatro animais deu aos sete anjos sete taças de ouro, cheias da ira de Deus, aquele que vive para todo o sempre.
verses.en_web: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
verses.en_bbe: And one of the four beasts gave to the seven angels seven gold vessels full of the wrath of God, who is living for ever and ever.

verses.en: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.
verses.pt: E o templo se encheu com a fumaça da glória de Deus, e do seu poder; e ninguém podia entrar no templo, enquanto as sete pragas dos sete anjos não estivessem completas.
verses.en_web: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple, until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.
verses.en_bbe: And the house of God was full of smoke from the glory of God, and from his power, and no one was able to go into the house of God, till the seven punishments of the seven angels were ended.
